Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DataComp: In search of the next generation of multimodal datasets (2304.14108v1) · paper method: DataComp’s filtering track fixes the candidate pool and training compute by total samples seen while allowing the filtered dataset size to vary; it also offers a separate bring-your-own-data track and four compute scales.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DataComp: In search of the next generation of multimodal datasets (2304.14108v1) · paper method: The paper warns that ImageNet performance is not representative of every task and reports demographic biases in face classification; some tested BYOD sources can increase misclassification risk.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DataComp: In search of the next generation of multimodal datasets (2304.14108v1) · paper method: At xlarge scale, the image-based/CLIP-score intersection baseline named DataComp-1B contains 1.4B samples and reports 79.2% zero-shot ImageNet accuracy after 12.8B samples seen, versus 72.3% for no filtering under the table’s matched scale.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DataComp: In search of the next generation of multimodal datasets (2304.14108v1) · paper method: CommonPool generation starts from Common Crawl image URLs with nonempty alt-text, uses unsafe-content filtering and evaluation-image near-duplicate removal to construct the 12.8B xlarge pool, and provides face bounding-box metadata for default blurring during participant image download.
